fee_notes: Royalty is called the "Lifestyle Publications Cost" and equals 7% of "Advertising Value" (not gross sales in the traditional sense). It is deducted from amounts paid to the franchisor by advertisers engaged by the franchisee. No separate marketing/ad fund fee is disclosed. Additional fees include: Transfer Fee (greater of then-current initial franchise fee or 20% of purchase price); Additional Trainees/Replacement Training ($1,000 per trainee, increasable up to 20%/year); Growth to Gold Training Program ($1,000); Conference Fee ($2,000 per attendee per conference, increasable up to 20%/year); Non-Attendance Fee ($5,000 for missing mandatory in-person conferences); Additional Email Addresses ($20/month per address beyond 2 free addresses, increasable up to 20%/year); Liquidated Damages ($50,000 on default termination); Resale Assistance Fee ($10,000).
raw_excerpt:
Royalty (the "Lifestyle Publications Cost") | 7% of the Advertising Value | Monthly | The Lifestyle Publications Cost is deducted from amounts that are paid to us by advertisers you engage. See Notes (2) and (3).
Transfer Fee | Equal to the greater of Lifestyle Publications' then-current Initial Franchise Fee or 20% of the purchase price paid by the transferee to Publisher (or other transferor) | Before transfer | We must approve of any transfer.
Additional Trainees or Replacement Training | Our then-current fee, currently $1,000 per trainee | At time of training | See Note (4).
Growth to Gold Training Program | $1,000 | At time of training | You are responsible for transportation and expenses for food (if any), and wages while attending training.
Conference Fee | Our then-current fee, which is currently $2,000 per attendee per conference | Upon demand | We may increase this fee up to 20% per year.
Non-Attendance Fee | $5,000 | Upon demand | Payable if you fail to attend any in-person conference that we have designated as "mandatory" in the Manuals or otherwise in writing.
Additional Email Addresses | Our then-current fee, which is currently $20 per month, per email address | | Two "@citylifestyle.com" email addresses will be provided to you free of charge. If you would like to purchase additional email addresses, you must pay to us our then-current fee. We may increase this fee up to 20% per year.
Liquidated Damages | $50,000 | When incurred | If the Publisher Agreement is terminated due your default under the Publisher Agreement.
Resale Assistance Fee | $10,000, subject to applicable law | At time of engagement | If you engage us to assist you in finding a buyer for your Magazine.
